scope: Screened all150 cartilage-target states/evidence across reviewed000, then personally reread cartilage passages in all12 reports containing relevant numbered-grade evidence or adjacent qualifying language. Did not audit non-cartilage targets, view gold, relabel by regex, or edit published annotations.
principle: A grade number is not automatically unusable. Named ICRS and explicitly identified depth-based variants can establish depth; accompanying superficial/full-thickness descriptions can independently support a state. A2024 original study uses depth-based OuterbridgeII/III, so the word Outerbridge does not automatically imply missing depth. These unnamed-grade candidates need source-convention adjudication, not blanket rewriting.

primary_references.support: Official ICRS classification distinguishes superficial grade1, grade2 below half-depth and grade3 deeper defects; read directly.
2024 original research Table1 employs depth-based OuterbridgeII/III. Table indexed content checked; direct publisher fetch timed out. Demonstrates variant/context matters.

retention_condition_for_ambiguous_grade2: An independent adjudicator may retain negative if source wording or validated source-reporting convention establishes a depth-based grade2. This audit alone does not establish that convention.
